zh.title: 美國航空推出無薪假方案 因空服員人力過剩
zh.summary: 美國航空正向員工提供無薪休假方案，主要原因為該公司目前出現空服員人力過剩的情況。這項獲得工會支持的計劃將提供為期一個月的無薪假，讓參與員工在保留相關福利的同時，也能為資淺空服員釋出更多飛行執勤的機會。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空目前正在向旗下空服員提供自願性質的無薪休假方案。航空公司採取此項措施的主要原因，在於該公司現階段出現空服員人力過剩的情況。
這項特別方案獲得工會的正式支持，為選擇參與的員工提供為期一個月的無薪休假時間。在無薪假期間，參與員工將能夠繼續保留原有的各項權益與福利。
此外，這項無薪休假機制在保留參與員工福利的同時，也能夠為資淺空服員釋出更多的飛行執勤機會。

en.title: American Airlines Offers Unpaid Leaves of Absence Due to Excess Flight Attendants
en.summary: American Airlines is offering unpaid leaves of absence to cabin crew because the airline currently has too many flight attendants. According to media reports from Simple Flying, the union-backed initiative offers a full month of unpaid leave to participating employees. While taking part in the program, crew members preserve their overall benefits, and the temporary leave program simultaneously serves to open up flight opportunities for junior flight attendants within the airline.
body: According to a news report from Simple Flying, American Airlines is offering voluntary unpaid leaves of absence to its cabin crew members. The carrier is implementing this initiative because it currently has too many flight attendants.

The union-backed program offers eligible staff a full month of unpaid leave. Crucially, employees who participate in the program will continue to preserve their standard company benefits during their time away.
In addition to preserving benefits, the temporary leave program is designed to open up more flight opportunities for junior flight attendants across the carrier's flight network.
